channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, AI, Tech & Research, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, AI, Tech & Research, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Arts at CERN: Grand Prix Resonance 2027 (two-month CERN residency for Geneva-based duos and collectives) (closes 23 Nov)
item.description:
Arts at CERN, with the City of Geneva and the Republic and Canton of Geneva
Deadline: 23 Nov 2026
Award: CHF 30,000 grant for research, development and production, plus a monthly stipend of CHF 5,000 per artist for a duo or CHF 10,000 per month for a collective, for two months; curatorial mentoring. No application fee stated.

Resonance is Arts at CERN's residency for Geneva-based artists working at the intersection of art, science and technology.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ETC Digital Theatre Programme: Research and Development Sprints 2027-28 (cross-border theatre and digital artist teams) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
European Theatre Convention (ETC) with the Akademie für Theater und Digitalität, Dortmund
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 3,000 development grant shared between the two partner theatres, plus up to EUR 2,860 from ETC for the Digital Expert's travel, accommodation and subsistence. The theatres must put the Digital Expert on their payroll at their usual creative fee. No application fee.

ETC's Digital Theatre Programme pairs two member theatres from different countries with a Digital Expert to research and develop artistic uses of technology in theatre: motion capture, coding, mixed, augmented and virtual reality, robotics and interaction design.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: H401 WONDER open call: 4-week artist residency in Amsterdam on women in the European Resistance (EUR 3,000 fee plus production budget) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
H401 (Stichting Herengracht 401), within the EU-funded WONDER project led by ECCOM
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: Artist fee of EUR 3,000, production costs reimbursed up to EUR 1,000, plus travel, accommodation (if applicable) and subsistence under EU travel guidelines. Travel and accommodation for the final event in Rome are also covered. No application fee stated.

Women Narratives during the European Resistance (WONDER) is a 15-month EU project (CERV programme) in five countries; each partner hosts one artist, and this is the Dutch call, for 1 artist.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ARCHAIVE International Open Call: Artist Residencies on AI and Cultural Memory 2027 (closes 7 Dec)
item.description:
ARCHAIVE consortium (MEET Digital Culture Center, NewArt Foundation, Museu Zer0, Sound & Vision, PUBLIC ART LAB)
Deadline: 7 Dec 2026, 23:55 CET
Award: EUR 5,000 artist fee per artist, paid in instalments, plus travel and accommodation covered by a separate production budget; 10 hours of technical mentoring per artist. No application fee.

ARCHAIVE, a Creative Europe project led by MEET Digital Culture Center in Milan with NewArt Foundation (Barcelona), Museu Zer0 (Tavira), Netherlands Institute for Sound & Vision and PUBLIC ART LAB (Berlin), invites emerging and mid-career artists to engage critically with generative AI through...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Planetary Transitions 2027: Potsdam Artist Residency (EUR 2,500/month, 4 to 6 months at a sustainability research institute) (closes 7 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Research Institute for Sustainability (RIFS) at GFZ, with the City of Potsdam and the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program
Deadline: 7 Feb 2027
Award: Monthly stipend of EUR 2,500, plus a lump sum for travel to Potsdam and back, and up to EUR 5,000 housing support if you stay in Potsdam. No application fee stated.

An art-science residency that brings an international artist into the Research Institute for Sustainability (RIFS) in Potsdam to work alongside researchers on sustainability and planetary transitions. Run since 2025 by RIFS at GFZ, the City of Potsdam and the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Schloss Wiepersdorf Individual and Collaborative Fellowships 2028 (Brandenburg; EUR 1,200/month plus room and board) (closes 15 Apr 2027)
item.description:
Schloss Wiepersdorf (state of Brandenburg)
Deadline: 15 Apr 2027, 23:59 CEST
Award: EUR 1,200 per month stipend, a one-time EUR 480 material grant, room and board, and German visa costs where needed. No application fee.

Three-month residential fellowships at Schloss Wiepersdorf for artists, writers, composers and scholars from Germany and abroad. Fellows get room, board, a EUR 1,200 monthly stipend and a material grant; fine artists get a studio where space allows.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Democracy Foundation: Democracy Residency 'European Dream' 2027 (Kuldiga, Latvia; Liepaja European Capital of Culture) (closes 15 Nov)
item.description:
Democracy Foundation (Kuldiga), part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme
Deadline: 15 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 1,000 stipend per participant (covering expenses during the residency, including travel), plus up to EUR 1,000 per participant to develop and run their activity, and accommodation in Kuldiga's Old Town. Six participants. No application fee stated.

International interdisciplinary residency run by the Democracy Foundation in Kuldiga, Latvia, as part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: EHIN European Hybrid Intelligence Network: Dirty Lab Artist Residencies in Biocomputing (2027) (closes 4 Dec)
item.description:
European Hybrid Intelligence Network (Kersnikova, ZKM, Kontejner, LABoral, CPN, GLUON), co-funded by Creative Europe
Deadline: 4 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 25,000 fixed residency grant per artist (6 artists), covering fee (max 35%) and production; travel and accommodation arranged separately with the host; optional extra co-production budget in Phase 2. No application fee.

EHIN invites artists to explore hybrid intelligence through the shared agency of the more-than-human world: biocomputing, interspecies and multi-species communication, biofabrication, sensing and biohybrid systems, building new artistic narratives rooted in ecological knowledge.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Realities in Transition RiT2 Open Call #3: Uncharted Grounds, a VRChat world residency with L.E.V. Festival (EUR 10,000 fee plus up to EUR 15,000 production)
item.description: Realities in Transition (RiT2, Creative Europe), with L.E.V. Festival · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 gross artist fee per selected artist (paid in three instalments) plus up to EUR 15,000 gross production budget shared among the team. No travel or accommodation included. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: Schaufler Residency@TU Dresden 2027 (six-month art and science residency, Energy Cultures in Transition)
item.description: Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden (TUD Dresden University of Technology and The Schaufler Foundation) · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · Fellowship of EUR 3,000 net per month for six months (EUR 18,000), plus a production grant of up to EUR 10,000 for a solo exhibition at the TUD University Gallery in autumn 2027, a studio on campus and help finding accommodation. No application fee.

item.title: TRACES Art & Science @ Energypolis 2027: residency at the EPFL Laboratory for Energy Materials (Sion)
item.description: Foundation for the Sustainable Development of Mountain Regions (FDDM) with EPFL Valais-Wallis · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · Artist stipend of CHF 2,000 per month (CHF 6,000 total) covering living and research costs, housing in Sion, travel from home and back up to CHF 1,500, and a separate production budget set by the curator. No application fee.

item.title: HIAP: Learning Materials International Artist Residency 2027 (Suomenlinna, Helsinki)
item.description: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme), with Kone Foundation · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Working grant of EUR 1,350 per month (EUR 4,050 total for 90 days) via Kone Foundation, material budget up to EUR 750, access budget up to EUR 1,000, one return trip covered (slow travel encouraged), plus accommodation and workspace. For collectives, the working grant can be paid to one individual only and there is no additional travel budget.

item.title: Art Explora x Cité internationale des arts Residency, 7th Call (Paris)
item.description: Art Explora Foundation and Cité internationale des arts · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 per month living stipend plus up to EUR 3,000 production grant, a furnished live-work studio of around 50 m2 at the Cité internationale des arts, round-trip travel to Paris and curatorial mentoring. No application fee.

item.title: OASis Bom Dia Residency 2027 at Cultivamos Cultura (Sao Luis, Portugal)
item.description: Cultivamos Cultura (European OASis project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,300 project fee, travel budget up to EUR 500, production and material expenses up to EUR 1,600 (pre-approved), food per diem, plus free accommodation in a private room in a shared farmhouse and access to a workspace or studio and all Cultivamos Cultura spaces and resources.
